name: u9_dist
_comment: U9 wave 3: landing distance gate. Inertialess Kit Crawler 200 (w2_u9c200 without the derelict bit: w3_u9c200) requests landing at Kit Port (`l`), flies out 4 s, turns 180 deg (Turn 30: 2.06 s), then approaches in 0.35 s thrust steps, stopping dead each time and pressing `l`; the first `l` that lands gives the distance (planet offset in the step shots, analysis/blob_offset.mjs).
